scope: Independent review of mfe-base and mfe-ratan-container provider/API compatibility, routing, current tile state, and CES role-owned write guards. BFF production change is excluded from independent review because this reviewer authored it.

closed_findings.after: Admission requires one matching EMS3 route by tile ID and nonblank route features.
closed_findings.execution_owner: Root owns actual portal execution. This reviewer did not repeat it.
closed_findings.severity: P2; valid CES tile could be unavailable; live frequency unmeasured.

closed_findings.after: Configured non-EMS2 aliases hold writes before resolved targets are filtered. Absent aliases do not broaden the hold.

additional_checks.mixed_source_ems2_projection: Inspected subject-level filtering; mixed entity rows retain their EMS2 subjects.
additional_checks.current_tile_authority: Inspected findTile, canOpenTile, dispatcher launch, mounted Container, workspace validation, and drawer replacement. Persisted workspace data selects current catalog definitions.
additional_checks.additive_apis: Inspected original hasPermission(code), getUser envelope, ordinary launch calls, additive scoped authenticator, and scoped role-list accessor.

bff_selected_source_tests.independence: Executed by BFF implementation author; these are validation evidence, not independent BFF review.

known_design_boundaries: Identical feature codes configured under conflicting providers or applications remain denied for an unscoped call. An explicit bound facade is required to identify the caller.
CES scalar role ownership, role-query semantics, multiple-role exclusions, and trusted data-profile rules remain unresolved. CES role-owned writes remain pending.
CES featureless BFF bypass does not grant frontend tile admission.
limits: Controlled hook/store tests substitute HTTP and UI confirmation boundaries. No backend mutation or enterprise call is executed.
Captured EMS2 data reproduces API compatibility, not current production reachability or impact frequency.
Full base portal browser execution is owned by root; this review does not duplicate or claim it.
Complete container build and full BFF Maven/controller integration remain outside these selected checks.
No deployment, business acceptance, publication approval or live CES parity is established.
Container is a filesystem copy without an independent Git revision. Durable original authenticator bytes are retained once and hash-bound in review-baseline-binding.json.
